description: Defines the DepositRecurringDetail class which encapsulates deposit details for recurring deposit products and accounts, including methods for creation, updating, copying, and accessing deposit properties.

classes.name: DepositRecurringDetail
classes.description: Embeddable class representing recurring deposit details, including properties for mandatory deposit, withdrawal allowance, and future payment adjustments, with methods for creation, update, copy, and property access.

methods.name: createFrom
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new DepositRecurringDetail instance with specified deposit properties.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates deposit details based on changes indicated in a JsonCommand object, returning a map of actual changes made.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current DepositRecurringDetail instance.
